audit.scope: All shared UI components in components/ui/, components/cards/, components/agent-states/, shell/

contrast.standard: 4.5:1 normal text, 3:1 large text and meaningful non-text components
contrast.details: All text uses semantic token colors (--nova-text, --nova-text-muted, --nova-text-subtle) on token backgrounds. Badge variants use white text on dark backgrounds for sufficient contrast. No hardcoded hex values in components.

labels.standard: Every interactive element has an accessible name
labels.details: TextField, TextArea, DatePicker use label + htmlFor + id. Combobox, Select use aria-label on clear/chevron buttons. Buttons have visible text or aria-label/sr-only. Badge has visible text. CardState uses role=alert/role=status with aria-label. EmptyState has title/description.

focusOrder.standard: Focus follows logical DOM order, no trapped focus
focusOrder.details: Dialog uses Radix Dialog primitive with focus trap and return focus. Tabs uses Radix Tabs with roving tabindex. All interactive elements are natively focusable. No custom focus management that breaks tab order.

aria.standard: ARIA roles and attributes used correctly
aria.details: Combobox: role=combobox, aria-expanded, aria-invalid, aria-autocomplete, aria-controls. CardState: role=alert for error/denied, role=status for loading/empty, aria-busy=true for loading, aria-live=polite. EmptyState/EmptyLoadingOfflineDeniedState: role=status via EmptyState. Dialog: Radix Dialog provides aria-modal, role=dialog.

keyboard.details: Combobox: ArrowUp/Down, Enter, Escape, Tab. Dialog: Escape closes, focus trapped. Tabs: Arrow navigation. All buttons and links are natively keyboard activatable. No mouse-only interactions.

hitTargets.details: Buttons use h-9 (36px) minimum with icon buttons at size-9/10 (36-40px). Touch targets meet 40-44px minimum via padding and min-height. Combobox input h-9. Badge uses px-2.5 py-0.5 with adequate touch area.

componentResults.text-field: pass — aria-invalid, aria-describedby, label+htmlFor, error role=alert
componentResults.text-area: pass — aria-invalid, aria-describedby, label+htmlFor, error role=alert

componentResults.combobox: pass — role=combobox, aria-expanded, aria-invalid, keyboard nav
